hero.title: Up to €1,000 Budget for Your Services.
hero.subtitle: Your patients receive a health budget of up to €3,000. Up to €1,000 of that is available for naturopathy, osteopathy, and alternative therapies. For you, that means: full treatment cycles and no more therapy dropouts.

problem.title: Does This Sound Familiar?
problem.text: You know exactly which treatment would help your patient right now. 10 sessions of osteopathy, a holistic pain therapy, a complete TCM program. But after the third session, the patient drops out. Not because the therapy isn't working, but because the costs are too high. That's frustrating for you as a practitioner and harmful to your patient.

budget.title: The Healio Health Budget
budget.subtitle: Your patients combine the IKK health insurance bonus with supplementary insurance to receive a real budget for health services.
budget.totalDesc: over 2 years through IKK bonus + supplementary insurance
budget.naturheilkundeDesc: For naturopaths, osteopathy, TCM, chiropractic and more
budget.sehhilfenDesc: For glasses, contact lenses and prescription sunglasses
budget.ikkDesc: Annual bonus from the statutory health insurance

partners.title: Who Is Healio For?
partners.subtitle: These professionals benefit directly from their patients' and customers' health budget.
partners.heilpraktikerDesc: Up to €1,000 for your treatments. Your patients can afford the full therapy.
partners.osteopathDesc: Osteopathic treatments are covered by the naturopathy budget. Complete treatment cycles instead of single sessions.
partners.tcmDesc: Acupuncture, herbal therapy, Tuina. Your patients can complete the entire TCM program.
partners.chiropraktikerDesc: Chiropractic adjustments and treatment series are covered through the naturopathy budget.
partners.brillenladenDesc: Up to €600 vision budget. Your customers can afford the glasses they truly want.
partners.hebammeDesc: Recommend the health budget to your families for preventive care, naturopathy, and child health services.

solution.title: This Is How Easy It Works for You.
solution.relaxedPatientsDesc: Place our information cards in your waiting room or hand them out directly. We handle everything else. Consultation, application, processing.
solution.sustainableTherapyDesc: Patients with a health budget don't drop out after the third session. They stay until the end of therapy. That improves your outcomes and your revenue.
solution.protectedTimeDesc: The partnership is completely free. We deliver the information materials at no charge. No contracts, no obligations.

steps.step1Desc: 15 minutes is all it takes. We explain the concept and you decide if it fits your practice.
steps.step2Desc: You receive our premium display stand with flyers for your waiting room. Free and ready to set up.
steps.step3Desc: Your patients scan the QR code, secure their budget, and can afford your treatment. You focus on healing.
